text: GameStop issued a non-binding acquisition offer for eBay at a valuation exceeding its own market capitalization. No engagement with target management is established. Financing includes partial debt support and prospective equity issuance. Target board review pending; market pricing diverges from offer level.

meta.note: Legitimacy vs contest dominance overlap; classification favors contest due to active bid without acceptance.

text: Jeanine Pirro moved to vacate prior rulings instead of appealing judicial blocks on subpoenas targeting Federal Reserve leadership under Jerome Powell. Judicial invalidation remains in place pending ruling. Investigative posture remains conditionally open; executive, judicial, and prosecutorial positions remain non-unified.

meta.note: Withdrawal vs authority-split overlap; dual-layer conflict retained without escalation.
